live_order_policy: User authorizes autonomous execution after thesis validation without per-trade user approval. Place trades only while the US regular market session is open. Complete the broker review immediately before placement, obey any broker-enforced confirmation requirement that cannot be bypassed, persist every decision, and learn from outcomes.

tactical_swing_sleeve.purpose: Short-horizon, catalyst-driven swing trades that pass every validation and execution gate.

results_driven_sizing.buy_notional: requested percent of live total_value x thesis outcome multiplier
results_driven_sizing.size_multiplier: public.thesis_sizing(): half-Kelly on trade_outcomes, 0.25..1.0, thin samples (n<5) 0.5
mechanical_limits: spendable cash: min(cash, buying_power), no margin
positive finite dollar amount or share quantity within available shares
US regular session open (orders are regular-hours market orders)
results_driven_sizing.decided: 2026-09-26 David: size follows results with no hard cap per position
results_driven_sizing.entry_blocks: rejected or killed thesis (all stewards); QUANTANAMO equity entries also need a hardening thesis at confidence >= 80
results_driven_sizing.no_fixed_rails: 2026-09-26 David: 'Kill the old rules!' No trade count, spread block, execution window buffer, fixed add %, add count or spacing, reduce band, or averaging-down ban.
results_driven_sizing.learned_rules: Beliefs and lessons in force (belief_updates meta.kind = playbook_rule, research_lessons) are learned rules scored by outcomes and stay in force.

execution_gates.guidance_not_blocks: Wide spreads and the first/last 15 minutes of the regular session are guidance for judgment, not blocks.

position_management.add_sizing: requested percent of live total_value x thesis outcome multiplier, limited by spendable cash (no fixed add %, count, spacing or averaging-down rule)
position_management.reduce_sizing: model-requested partial percent (0 < % < 100); no fixed band
